Priya K.: Morning — quick async standup.
Priya K.: What I did: triaged spike from Meridian (webhook 429s), opened incident with eng-oncall, added temporary rate-limit mitigation.
Priya K.: Blockers: transport header rotation for renewals pipeline is blocked by secret access (KMS approval pending). Need legal signoff before we send renewal notices.
Priya K.: Today: finishing retry/backoff patch for webhooks, will pair with Samir for deploy window, and prep renewal messaging draft once KMS cleared.
Samir R.: Thanks Priya — I can jump on the deploy pairing at 11:30 PT. For the KMS thing, I asked infra for an express ticket — tagged infra-ops@ here.
Samir R.: Also noted the retry patch needs a small config change: set `MAX_RETRIES=5` and enable jitter. Patch in PR #482.
Jess L.: FYI the account team flagged HorizonPay renewal — they asked about SLA credits if spikes continue. I told them we're patching today and to hold off on contract moves til tomorrow.
Jess L.: Also pinging @Priya K. on whether renewal messaging should mention temporary rate limits. I worry about churn if we surface too many infra details.
Priya K.: Good point Jess — prefer to keep messaging high level: "we experienced intermittent delivery delays; fix deployed; no customer action required." I'll post a draft later for review.
Eli (CS Bot): Incident update: webhook 429 rate is down from 11% -> 1.8% over last 10m after partial rollout of retry patch.
Samir R.: Nice — logs show fewer 5xx now. Quick debug snippet I ran:
```
# curl example to repro
curl -v -H "X-Customer: meridian" https://hooks.redwood.test/payload || true
```
Samir R.: If anyone sees any recurring 429s after full rollout, ping me and I'll revert the header rotation until KMS is ready. :thumbsup:
Jess L.: Noted. I'll delay HorizonPay renewal call by 24h and update the renewal tracker.
Priya K.: Blocker note for onboarding queue: an enterprise customer reported duplicate embeddings on ingest (likely retry semantics). I've opened a CS ticket with sample IDs. Will loop in eng-ml if it reproduces after retry patch.
Samir R.: OK. If duplicates persist, we should add idempotency-key check on the ingest side as a short-term guard.
Priya K.: Thanks all — will post a summary in the renewal thread and share the messaging draft for review.
Jess L.: 👍 thanks — keep us posted.
Eli (CS Bot): Reminder: weekly renewals sync tomorrow 9am PT.
